passages.note: Final-passage No vote on a multi-subject tax omnibus; cannot show which part, if any, she objected to.

Bill text amends dozens of unrelated tax provisions (income tax rates, property tax, sales tax exemptions, unemployment wage base, tax credits, fire district levies), confirming the omnibus/multi-subject shape.
